output.reason: [ev-2bd1a74f9c4a] says that before 1.13.0, policy exceptions were allowed in all namespaces. It says this release "changes the defaults to disable the policy exceptions" and only allows them in a specified namespace. It also tells operators to follow the upgrade guidance to keep backward compatibility. With the new defaults, existing PolicyException resources are no longer honoured. That is more than a default that keeps working, so setting-ignored (action-required) fits. High severity is reasonable because exceptions would stop exempting resources from policies.
